content.comment_body: Hello, I have two [product_name] controllers, while working on [product_name] software version [version_no]. Configuration was made as a Network project. I'm controlling everything from the [product_name] web app on my phone. I programmed the controllers about four months ago. Everything worked fine until one week ago. Now, when I try to access the [product_name] app using the controller's static IP, the site can't be reached. The same issue occurs when trying to connect from [product_name] software—it shows an error: unable to access the remote device. I have restarted the router and powered the controllers off and on, but the problem persists. I can still see both controllers' IP addresses using Network scan and Ping, but attempting to connect via browser returns the site as unreachable.
What do you mean by [product_name] app? Do you mean the extended web server of the [product_name] controller?
Yes, because the official Android app for [product_name] is not available on the Serbian Play Store.
Does your router use DHCP? If so, are the IP addresses of the [product_name] controllers within the DHCP range?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing sudden connectivity issues between their mobile and browser applications and two [product_name] controllers. Although network diagnostics indicate the devices are visible and respond to ping, the web interface is unreachable and the software reports it cannot access remote modules. Previous stable operation and basic troubleshooting measures have not resolved the issue, pointing to reliability and access problems.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable, uninterrupted remote access to [product_name] controllers through the Web Editor and related tools, with minimal risk of unexpected connection issues after the initial configuration.
